events.name: 地瓜机器人黑客松 2026 (D-Robotics Hackathon 2026)
events.location: Shanghai Zhangjiang Science Hall (上海张江科学会堂)
events.eligibility: Open to hardware/software/product/design builders; solo signup supported (teams of 2-4); in-person attendance required; domestic travel, meals, and lodging covered after admission.
events.hardware_or_stack: D-Robotics RDK (X5 / S100 / S600) as core compute platform; on-site robots (humanoids, quadrupeds, arms/hands), Orbbec depth cameras, Feetech servos, 3D printing/PCB, Baidu AI Cloud & Qoder/WorkBuddy tools.
events.notes: Theme is open. Web signup button displayed '报名时间加载中' during checks; verify actual registration form via D-Robotics official WeChat or partner channels before 2026-11-30.

events.name: 造点“硬”的 · 创出“七”迹 (立创开源七周年硬件赛)
events.eligibility: Open to hardware makers; must use EasyEDA Pro (嘉立创EDA专业版) and include circuits + 7th-anniversary logo; open-source submission required.
events.hardware_or_stack: EasyEDA Pro PCB design, 3D shell, open-source hardware.
events.prize_pool: Component/PCB/3D-printing vouchers, custom mechanical keyboards, JLC Beans

events.name: BK7258 无限智造挑战赛 (立创 × 博通集成 BEKEN)
events.eligibility: Open to developers/makers; original hardware project based on BK7258 module using EasyEDA Pro.
events.hardware_or_stack: BEKEN BK7258 module + EasyEDA Pro PCB; schematic/PCB completion qualifies for module/PCB/component/3D-print coupons.
events.prize_pool: Up to 2,000 RMB JD E-cards + component/PCB vouchers
events.notes: Asynchronous online hardware build contest open through year-end.

events.name: 绿联 AI NAS 黑客松 (Skills 生态共创计划)
events.location: Online (finalist remote NAS verification; Jan 9 offline awards)
events.eligibility: Solo or team; no prior NAS purchase required; top 25 finalists get remote AI NAS access Dec 13-17.
events.prize_pool: 34,000 RMB + UGREEN AI NAS iDX6011 Pro
events.notes: Good async alternative if unable to travel to Shanghai on Dec 5-7.

events.name: Build the Autodesk University 2027 Product
events.eligibility: Global hardware builders (subject to official contest rules).
events.hardware_or_stack: Autodesk Fusion, Arduino UNO Q (4G), PCBWay ($300 prototyping grant for selected hardware applicants).
events.prize_pool: $1,000 + Fusion license + winning product manufactured (~750 units for AU 2027)
events.notes: Strong product-narrative focus: handheld/wearable smart accessory.

events.name: Emotion in Motion (Arduino & Renesas)
events.eligibility: Global makers and students (500 Arduino UNO R4 WiFi boards given away).
events.hardware_or_stack: Arduino UNO R4 WiFi (Renesas RA4M1 + ESP32-S3 + 12x8 LED matrix)
events.notes: Directly aligned with 'humanizing hardware' (emotion + fine motion).

events.name: Infineon Boss Battle in the AI Arena
events.eligibility: Global developers (free kit giveaway already completed; low-cost kit available to purchase).
events.hardware_or_stack: Infineon PSOC Edge E84 AI Kit + ModusToolbox + DEEPCRAFT Studio
events.notes: Focuses on on-device voice/radar-gesture cyberpunk edge AI.

events.name: Agentware: AI Agent Hackathon (Hackathon Raptors)
events.registration_window: Open prior to 2026-11-27 kickoff via Discord
events.eligibility: Teams of 1-4 globally; open-source OSI license; new code only during 72h.
events.hardware_or_stack: Software / AI agents (any stack, voice/screen/MCP/webhooks; evaluated on unattended runs & Trap Pack prompt-injection safety).
events.notes: Software-only (not hardware), strong emphasis on agent reliability and guardrails.

events.name: MIT Reality Hack 2027
events.eligibility: Global applicants (engineers, designers, storytellers, artists); selective admission.
events.hardware_or_stack: XR headsets, wearables, sensors, edge AI (Meta, Qualcomm, Google DeepMind sponsored in 2026).
events.notes: Also runs hybrid 'Reality Hack at AWE' in May/June 2027. Premier benchmark for experiential HMI storytelling.

events.name: TreeHacks 2027 (Stanford)
events.eligibility: University students (food and travel support noted on site).
events.prize_pool: $1M+ total prize pool (historically listed on site)
events.notes: Flagship Stanford hackathon; login required to check exact closing deadline.

events.name: Build18 (CMU ECE Hardware Hackathon)
events.eligibility: Teams of 2-5; at least one team member must be a CMU ECE major.
events.hardware_or_stack: $250-$300 parts budget per team; open theme.
events.prize_pool: Hardware awards & First Penguin / Outstanding Project honors
events.notes: Public project archive at build18.org/garage (193 projects) is an essential inspiration reference.

events.name: MakeUofT (University of Toronto)
events.registration_window: Interest form open; formal applications not yet open
events.notes: Canada's largest hardware makeathon; 24-hour weekend sprint format.

events.name: MakeMIT
events.event_dates: Annual spring semester (2026 edition partnered with Harvard)
events.registration_window: Not currently open (official site returned HTTP 403)
events.hardware_or_stack: Rapid hardware prototyping, Raspberry Pi / microcontrollers / sensors / robotics.
events.notes: 2026 projects (MakeMIT x Harvard) verified on GitHub (e.g., Locky, Scribblr, Bless You Polar Bear, Whackathon, A.L.I.C.E.).

events.name: MakeHarvard
events.event_dates: Site currently shows 2025-02-08 to 2025-02-09; 2026 collaborated with MakeMIT
events.hardware_or_stack: Hardware prototyping; awards include Overall, Best Pitch, Most Sustainable.
events.notes: Good benchmark for concise product pitching on hardware hacks.

events.name: AdventureX (杭州青年黑客松)
events.eligibility: Open to young builders globally regardless of degree; travel/lodging subsidies available.
events.hardware_or_stack: 72h free-form creation; 2026 partners included Rokid, Insta360, Agibot, Galaxea.
events.notes: Official documentary for 2026 released 2026-11-07; also listed as a community partner for D-Robotics 2026.

events.name: Hackaday Supercon & Hackaday Prize
events.event_dates: Supercon 2026 ran 2026-11-06 to 2026-11-08; Prize site shows 2023 edition
events.registration_window: 2026 Supercon ended; Prize currently inactive on official redirect
events.hardware_or_stack: Custom PCBs, conference badge hacking, assistive tech, green hardware.
events.notes: Worth studying past Prize finalists for authentic problem-first hardware narratives.

events.name: Hack K-State (Hack Cats) 2026
events.eligibility: US high school, undergraduate, and graduate students.
events.hardware_or_stack: 36h MLH event; free hardware/smart devices available on site.

events.name: XbotPark (松山湖机器人基地 / 深圳科创学院体系)
events.location: Dongguan Songshan Lake / Shenzhen / Ningbo / Changzhou
events.eligibility: Robotics & smart-hardware startup teams or student founders.
events.hardware_or_stack: End-to-end consumer/industrial hardware product definition & supply chain.
events.notes: Not a weekend hackathon, but its product-definition philosophy directly shapes D-Robotics judging (e.g., judge Yu Ying).
